title: Builders Wand Lite
description: A lightweight builder's wand plugin that lets you place multiple blocks at once by extending or stacking along connected surfaces - perfect for fast, efficient building without the overhead of a full suite.
body:
# Builders Wand Lite

[Builders Wand Showcase](https://imgur.com/a/builders-wand-ultimate-showcase-3M1YPFh)

  Place multiple blocks at once with a single right-click. Builders Wand Lite detects the surface you're looking at and
  intelligently selects connected matching blocks — then places on top of them instantly.

  ---

  ## ✨ Features

  - **Smart surface detection** — automatically identifies horizontal floors and vertical walls, locking selection to
  the correct plane
  - **Two building modes**
    - **Stack** — places a new layer directly on top of the selected surface
    - **Extend** — pushes the surface outward in a chosen direction
  - **Particle preview** — see exactly which blocks will be placed before you click, with Center or Corners display
  styles
  - **Item consumption** — optional; wands can require materials from your inventory to place blocks
  - **Durability** — configurable per-wand use limit with action bar warnings and item break on depletion
  - **Per-wand settings** — building mode, direction, and particle style are stored in each wand's NBT, so multiple
  wands can have different configs simultaneously
  - **Material whitelist / blacklist** — restrict which block types each wand can interact with
  - **Undo support** — reverse the last placement
  - **Protection plugin compatibility** — respects existing build protection before placing any block

  ---

  ## 🔧 Permissions

  | Permission | Description |
  |---|---|
  | `builderswandlite.use` | Allows using any builders wand |

  ---

  ## 💎 Want more?

  Check out **[Builders Wand Ultimate](https://builtbybit.com/resources/builders-wand-ultimate.75091/?preview=1)** for wand storage inventory, 5 wand tiers, economy integration, CoreProtect
  logging, ItemsAdder & Nexo custom block support, and a full GUI configuration menu.
